s0501.literal: Second month, on renxu day the Palace Domestic Service Court was changed to the Central Domestic Affairs Court, rank 1a.
s0501.idiomatic: Second month, on renxu day the Palace Domestic Service Court was changed to the Central Domestic Affairs Court, rank 1a.

s0502.literal: On jiazi day, because the empress received seal and regalia, officials were dispatched to offer sacrifices and announce to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb and the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0502.idiomatic: On jiazi day, because the empress received seal and regalia, officials were dispatched to offer sacrifices and announce to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb and the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0503.literal: On dingchou day the sun was red as ochre.
s0503.idiomatic: On dingchou day the sun was red as ochre.

s0504.literal: On jimao day the two hundred thousand shi of official grain lent to famine victims in Yidu were exempted from repayment.
s0504.idiomatic: On jimao day the 200,000 shi of official grain lent to famine victims in Yidu were exempted from repayment.

s0505.literal: For Buddhist rites the monasteries daily used nine thousand four hundred forty sheep; an edict directed reverting to the old system and substituting vegetarian fare.
s0505.idiomatic: For Buddhist rites the monasteries daily used 9,440 sheep; an edict directed reverting to the old system and substituting vegetarian fare.

s0506.literal: Zhang Gui was ordered to take overall charge of the National University.
s0506.idiomatic: Zhang Gui was ordered to take overall charge of the National University.

s0507.literal: On gengchen day Jining Route suffered famine; the brewing of liquor was forbidden.
s0507.idiomatic: On gengchen day Jining Route suffered famine; the brewing of liquor was forbidden.

s0508.literal: On xinsi day an edict directed that revenue and grain, construction, litigation, and other matters all revert to the relevant offices, to clear the central secretariat's affairs.
s0508.idiomatic: On xinsi day an edict directed that revenue and grain, construction, litigation, and other matters all revert to the relevant offices, to clear the central secretariat's affairs.

s0509.literal: On renwu day northwestern princes Yexianbuhua presented horses, camels, and uncut jade.
s0509.idiomatic: On renwu day northwestern princes Yexianbuhua presented horses, camels, and uncut jade.

s0510.literal: On dinghai day an edict: "Officials serving outside the capital who should have official fields but do not — all are to be given Zhiyuan notes.
s0510.idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict directed, "Officials serving outside the capital who should have official fields but do not — all are to be given Zhiyuan notes.

s0511.literal: " Guaixi Prefecture was placed under the Bozhou Pacification Commission.
s0511.idiomatic: Guaixi Prefecture was placed under the Bozhou Pacification Commission.

s0512.literal: Merit Commissioner Yilianzhen and others memorialized through Buddhist rites to release serious criminals; this was not approved.
s0512.idiomatic: Merit Commissioner Yilianzhen and others memorialized through Buddhist rites to release serious criminals; this was not approved.

s0513.literal: The Emperor addressed those beside him, saying: "Muslims sell gems and jade to the court; We consider — what about these things makes them treasures? Only good men may be called treasures.
s0513.idiomatic: The Emperor addressed those beside him, saying, "Muslims sell gems and jade to the court; We consider — what about these things makes them treasures? Only good men may be called treasures.

s0514.literal: When good men are employed the common people are secure — this is what the state ought to treasure.
s0514.idiomatic: When good men are employed the common people are secure — this is what the state ought to treasure.

s0515.literal: " Third month, on bingshen day Censorate Vice Director Tuohuan Darqan was made censor-in-chief.
s0515.idiomatic: Third month, on bingshen day censorate vice director Tuohuan Darqan was made censor-in-chief.

s0516.literal: On gengzi day Mars transgressed Rampart Wall Formation.
s0516.idiomatic: On gengzi day Mars transgressed Rampart Wall Formation.

s0517.literal: Because Jinning, Datong, Daning, Sichuan, Gongchang, and Gansu suffered famine, the drinking of liquor was forbidden.
s0517.idiomatic: Because Jinning, Datong, Daning, Sichuan, Gongchang, and Gansu suffered famine, the drinking of liquor was forbidden.

s0518.literal: On bingwu day the empress of the Hongjira clan was installed; an edict was issued to the realm.
s0518.idiomatic: On bingwu day the empress of the Hongjira clan was installed; an edict was issued to the realm.

s0519.literal: On dingwei day a comet emerged at Well.
s0519.idiomatic: On dingwei day a comet emerged at Well.

s0520.literal: On renzi day Tuhulu said: "Your subjects' office is devoted to harmonizing governance; from last autumn until spring there has been severe drought, the people lack food, and moreover there has been frost, rain, and falling sand — the heavens show change — all because We cannot proclaim the sovereign's grace, causing these calamities; we beg to be dismissed to answer Heaven's mind.
s0520.idiomatic: On renzi day Tuhulu said, "Your subjects' office is devoted to harmonizing governance; from last autumn until spring there has been severe drought, the people lack food, and moreover there has been frost, rain, and falling sand — the heavens show change — all because We cannot proclaim the sovereign's grace, causing these calamities; we beg to be dismissed to answer Heaven's mind.

s0521.literal: " The Emperor said: "How could the matter concern you?
s0521.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "How could the matter concern you?

s0522.literal: Do not speak of it again.
s0522.idiomatic: Do not speak of it again.

s0523.literal: " Censorate Vice Director Hao Tianting submitted a memorial discussing current affairs; the Emperor commended and accepted it.
s0523.idiomatic: Censorate vice director Hao Tianting submitted a memorial discussing current affairs; the Emperor commended and accepted it.

s0524.literal: The Western monk Shusijiganjie'er was granted ten thousand ingots of notes.
s0524.idiomatic: The Western monk Shusijiganjie'er was granted 10,000 ingots of notes.

s0525.literal: On bingchen day, because the empress received seal and regalia, officials were dispatched to offer grateful thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0525.idiomatic: On bingchen day, because the empress received seal and regalia, officials were dispatched to offer grateful thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0526.literal: Because the severe drought had already lasted long, the Emperor burned incense in the palace and prayed silently; officials were dispatched separately to pray at various shrines — sweet rain poured down abundantly.
s0526.idiomatic: Because the severe drought had already lasted long, the Emperor burned incense in the palace and prayed silently; officials were dispatched separately to pray at various shrines — sweet rain poured down abundantly.

s0527.literal: An edict earnestly urged encouragement of agriculture and sericulture.
s0527.idiomatic: An edict earnestly urged encouragement of agriculture and sericulture.

s0528.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiazi day a comet was observed at the Directorate of Astronomy.
s0528.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on jiazi day a comet was observed at the Directorate of Astronomy.

s0529.literal: On guiyou day Princess Shouning was granted thirty-six Bactrian camels.
s0529.idiomatic: On guiyou day Princess Shouning was granted 36 Bactrian camels.

s0530.literal: On yihai day the imperial carriage proceeded to the Upper Capital.
s0530.idiomatic: On yihai day the imperial carriage proceeded to the Upper Capital.

s0531.literal: On bingzi day the king of Koryo abdicated; his heir Wang Zhan was made left grand councillor of the Eastern Campaign branch secretariat, pillar of state, and enfeoffed as king of Koryo.
s0531.idiomatic: On bingzi day the king of Koryo abdicated; his heir Wang Zhan was made left grand councillor of the Eastern Campaign branch secretariat, pillar of state, and enfeoffed as king of Koryo.

s0532.literal: On xinsi day Censor-in-Chief Berhu was further granted Grand Preceptor with the same ceremonial standing as the Three Excellencies and Grand Tutor.
s0532.idiomatic: On xinsi day censor-in-chief Berhu was further granted Grand Preceptor with the same ceremonial standing as the Three Excellencies and grand tutor.

s0533.literal: On renwu day the Central Auspicious Bureau was established, rank 4a.
s0533.idiomatic: On renwu day the Central Auspicious Bureau was established, rank 4a.

s0534.literal: On jiashen day an edict directed selecting worthy men to compile the national history.
s0534.idiomatic: On jiashen day an edict directed selecting worthy men to compile the national history.

s0535.literal: On yiyou day censorate officials said: "Wealthy men currying favor through special edicts indiscriminately receive ranks and titles.
s0535.idiomatic: On yiyou day censorate officials said, "Wealthy men currying favor through special edicts indiscriminately receive ranks and titles.

s0536.literal: The Huizheng and Xuanhui courts employ people, mostly streams of those dismissed for crimes.
s0536.idiomatic: The Huizheng and Xuanhui courts employ people, mostly streams of those dismissed for crimes.

s0537.literal: Close attendants feigning poverty mutually memorialized for grace and rewards.
s0537.idiomatic: Close attendants feigning poverty mutually memorialized for grace and rewards.

s0538.literal: Western monks, because of performing Buddhist rites, repeatedly released serious criminals.
s0538.idiomatic: Western monks, because of performing Buddhist rites, repeatedly released serious criminals.

s0539.literal: Officials serving outside the capital, having themselves violated criminal law, hastily sought inner edicts to escape punishment.
s0539.idiomatic: Officials serving outside the capital, having themselves violated criminal law, hastily sought inner edicts to escape punishment.

s0540.literal: Princes, imperial sons-in-law, temples and monasteries, and officials' landed estates — annual rent collection also greatly disturbed the people.
s0540.idiomatic: Princes, imperial sons-in-law, temples and monasteries, and officials' landed estates — annual rent collection also greatly disturbed the people.

s0541.literal: We request all these abuses be thoroughly reformed.
s0541.idiomatic: We request all these abuses be thoroughly reformed.

s0543.literal: " An edict halted non-urgent labor service.
s0543.idiomatic: An edict halted non-urgent labor service.

s0544.literal: Zhending, Baoding, Hejian, and Daning routes suffered famine; one-third of this year's field tax was exempted for all, and the brewing of liquor was still forbidden.
s0544.idiomatic: Zhending, Baoding, Hejian, and Daning routes suffered famine; one-third of this year's field tax was exempted for all, and the brewing of liquor was still forbidden.

s0545.literal: Annam sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
s0545.idiomatic: Annam sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

s0546.literal: Fifth month, on xinchou day Central Secretariat Right Vice Chancellor Wubadula was promoted to grand councillor; Left Vice Chancellor Baratuin was made right vice chancellor; Associate Administrator Abuhaya was made left vice chancellor; Central Secretariat deliberator Tuluhua Temur was made associate administrator; Shunde and Jining routes suffered famine; Chenzhou suffered flooding — relief was given in rice and notes, and the brewing of liquor was still forbidden.
s0546.idiomatic: Fifth month, on xinchou day central secretariat right vice chancellor Wubadula was promoted to grand councillor; left vice chancellor Baratuin was made right vice chancellor; associate administrator Abuhaya was made left vice chancellor; central secretariat deliberator Tuluhua Temur was made associate administrator; Shunde and Jining routes suffered famine; Chenzhou suffered flooding — relief was given in rice and notes, and the brewing of liquor was still forbidden.

s0547.literal: Tanzhou and Huolu County had hopper locusts.
s0547.idiomatic: Tanzhou and Huolu County had hopper locusts.

s0548.literal: Sixth month, on jiwei new moon the capital suffered an earthquake.
s0548.idiomatic: Sixth month, on jiwei new moon the capital suffered an earthquake.

s0549.literal: On guihai day Tuhulu and others, citing disasters and portents, begged to be dismissed; this was not approved.
s0549.idiomatic: On guihai day Tuhulu and others, citing disasters and portents, begged to be dismissed; this was not approved.

s0550.literal: On bingyin day the capital suffered an earthquake.
s0550.idiomatic: On bingyin day the capital suffered an earthquake.

s0551.literal: Xu Sijing, associate administrator, was placed in overall charge of the National University.
s0551.idiomatic: Xu Sijing, associate administrator, was placed in overall charge of the National University.

s0552.literal: On yihai day an edict addressed monks and laymen in litigation: relevant offices and the chief monk are jointly to hear cases; newly established landed estates are to pay tax as customarily required.
s0552.idiomatic: On yihai day an edict addressed monks and laymen in litigation: relevant offices and the chief monk are jointly to hear cases; newly established landed estates are to pay tax as customarily required.

s0553.literal: On bingzi day Prince Anhui was granted fifty taels of gold, seven hundred fifty taels of silver, one gold girdle set, and forty bolts each of silks and cloths.
s0553.idiomatic: On bingzi day Prince Anhui was granted 50 taels of gold, 750 taels of silver, one gold girdle set, and 40 bolts each of silks and cloths.

s0554.literal: On jimao day Hedong surveillance commissioner Zhao Jian said: "We request selecting upright and broadly learned men to serve as Hanlin Academician Reader and Hanlin Academician Explicator, expounding good governance to broaden the sovereign's hearing.
s0554.idiomatic: On jimao day Hedong surveillance commissioner Zhao Jian said, "We request selecting upright and broadly learned men to serve as Hanlin Academician Reader and Hanlin Academician Explicator, expounding good governance to broaden the sovereign's hearing.

s0556.literal: Censorate officials said: "In recent years surveillance commissions have often not devoted themselves to their duties; surveillance censors should be ordered to verify names against reality and demote or promote accordingly.
s0556.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "In recent years surveillance commissions have often not devoted themselves to their duties; surveillance censors should be ordered to verify names against reality and demote or promote accordingly.

s0557.literal: Guanghai and Yunnan and Gansu are far away; those transferred on reassignment fear going and refuse — we beg that hereafter one grade of rank be added.
s0557.idiomatic: Guanghai and Yunnan and Gansu are far away; those transferred on reassignment fear going and refuse — we beg that hereafter one grade of rank be added.

s0559.literal: " On renwu day surveillance censors were ordered to inspect and supervise education officials, assessing their best and worst.
s0559.idiomatic: On renwu day surveillance censors were ordered to inspect and supervise education officials, assessing their best and worst.

s0560.literal: On guiwei day officials were commissioned to select and reduce the palace guards.
s0560.idiomatic: On guiwei day officials were commissioned to select and reduce the palace guards.

s0561.literal: On jiashen day the Chongwen Pavilion was built at the National University directorate.
s0561.idiomatic: On jiashen day the Chongwen Pavilion was built at the National University directorate.

s0562.literal: Ten thousand horses were supplied to impoverished soldiers under Prince Bin Nanhuli and others.
s0562.idiomatic: 10,000 horses were supplied to impoverished soldiers under Prince Bin Nanhuli and others.

s0563.literal: The Song Confucians Zhou Dunyi, Cheng Hao, Cheng Hao's brother Yi, Zhang Zai, Shao Yong, Sima Guang, Zhu Xi, Zhang Shi, Lü Zuqian, and the former central secretariat left vice chancellor Xu Heng were granted secondary worship in the Confucian temple court.
s0563.idiomatic: The Song Confucians Zhou Dunyi, Cheng Hao, Cheng Hao's brother Yi, Zhang Zai, Shao Yong, Sima Guang, Zhu Xi, Zhang Shi, Lü Zuqian, and the former central secretariat left vice chancellor Xu Heng were granted secondary worship in the Confucian temple court.

s0564.literal: The people of Shangdu suffered famine; five thousand shi of grain were released and sold at reduced price for relief.
s0564.idiomatic: The people of Shangdu suffered famine; 5,000 shi of grain were released and sold at reduced price for relief.

s0565.literal: The Yellow River burst its banks at Chen, Bo, Suizhou, Kaifeng, and Chenliu counties, inundating common people's fields and dwellings.
s0565.idiomatic: The Yellow River burst its banks at Chen, Bo, Suizhou, Kaifeng, and Chenliu counties, inundating common people's fields and dwellings.

s0566.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jichou new moon Jupiter transgressed Well.
s0566.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on jichou new moon Jupiter transgressed Well.

s0567.literal: On xinmao day Venus was visible in daylight.
s0567.idiomatic: On xinmao day Venus was visible in daylight.

s0568.literal: On guisi day, because of performing Buddhist rites, twenty-nine prisoners were released.
s0568.idiomatic: On guisi day, because of performing Buddhist rites, 29 prisoners were released.

s0569.literal: Prince Xuannin Temurbuqa was granted one hundred twenty bolts of silks and cloths; Prince Anyuan and Yisidan and others each one hundred bolts.
s0569.idiomatic: Prince Xuannin Temurbuqa was granted 120 bolts of silks and cloths; Prince Anyuan and Yisidan and others each 100 bolts.

s0570.literal: Baoding, Zhending, and Hejian — displaced people flowed without cease; an order directed local relevant offices to supply two months' grain, and altogether exempt this year's corvée levies; all disaster-struck lands also relaxed prohibitions on mountains and marshes — hunters were not to enter those territories.
s0570.idiomatic: Baoding, Zhending, and Hejian — displaced people flowed without cease; an order directed local relevant offices to supply two months' grain, and altogether exempt this year's corvée levies; all disaster-struck lands also relaxed prohibitions on mountains and marshes — hunters were not to enter those territories.

s0571.literal: On jiawu day tea monopoly inspection and verification offices and tea transport license bureau officials were established.
s0571.idiomatic: On jiawu day tea monopoly inspection and verification offices and tea transport license bureau officials were established.

s0572.literal: On yiwei day Venus was visible in daylight.
s0572.idiomatic: On yiwei day Venus was visible in daylight.

s0573.literal: On gengzi day the Changqiu Temple was established, in charge of Emperor Wuzong's empress's palace administration, rank 3a.
s0573.idiomatic: On gengzi day the Changqiu Temple was established, in charge of Emperor Wuzong's empress's palace administration, rank 3a.

s0574.literal: An edict directed that apart from Prince Wei Amuge's annual grant, ten thousand ingots of notes be given.
s0574.idiomatic: An edict directed that apart from Prince Wei Amuge's annual grant, 10,000 ingots of notes be given.

s0575.literal: Imperial son-in-law Tuotiemur was granted one hundred fifty taels of gold, seven hundred fifty taels of silver, two thousand ingots of notes, and fifty bolts of silks and cloths.
s0575.idiomatic: Imperial son-in-law Tuotiemur was granted 150 taels of gold, 750 taels of silver, 2,000 ingots of notes, and 50 bolts of silks and cloths.

s0576.literal: On xinchou day the Sichuan and other places Confucian schools intendant office was re-established.
s0576.idiomatic: On xinchou day the Sichuan and other places Confucian schools intendant office was re-established.

s0577.literal: On renyin day the capital suffered an earthquake.
s0577.idiomatic: On renyin day the capital suffered an earthquake.

s0578.literal: Daning Route's salt levy for this year was exempted.
s0578.idiomatic: Daning Route's salt levy for this year was exempted.

s0579.literal: On dingwei day Princes Huoluosimi, Tuohuan, Nanhuli, and imperial son-in-law Mangudai were granted two hundred taels of gold, one thousand two hundred taels of silver, one thousand six hundred ingots of notes, and varying amounts of silks and cloths.
s0579.idiomatic: On dingwei day Princes Huoluosimi, Tuohuan, Nanhuli, and imperial son-in-law Mangudai were granted 200 taels of gold, 1,200 taels of silver, 1,600 ingots of notes, and varying amounts of silks and cloths.

s0580.literal: On jiyou day the Huaidong-Huaixi Circuit Pacification Commission was changed to the Huaidong Pacification Commission; the three Huaixi circuits were placed under Henan Province.
s0580.idiomatic: On jiyou day the Huaidong-Huaixi Circuit Pacification Commission was changed to the Huaidong Pacification Commission; the three Huaixi circuits were placed under Henan Province.

s0581.literal: An edict directed prefects and magistrates to encourage agriculture and sericulture; the diligent are to be promoted, the negligent demoted — established as regulation.
s0581.idiomatic: An edict directed prefects and magistrates to encourage agriculture and sericulture; the diligent are to be promoted, the negligent demoted — established as regulation.

s0582.literal: On bingchen day Venus was visible in daylight.
s0582.idiomatic: On bingchen day Venus was visible in daylight.

s0583.literal: On dingsi day Venus crossed the sky.
s0583.idiomatic: On dingsi day Venus crossed the sky.

s0584.literal: Mongol troops of Yunzhou lacked food; one shi of rice per household was granted.
s0584.idiomatic: Mongol troops of Yunzhou lacked food; one shi of rice per household was granted.

s0585.literal: Dependent counties of Xingguo had hopper locusts; grain was issued for relief.
s0585.idiomatic: Dependent counties of Xingguo had hopper locusts; grain was issued for relief.

s0586.literal: Eighth month, on wuwu new moon Venus was visible in daylight.
s0586.idiomatic: Eighth month, on wuwu new moon Venus was visible in daylight.

s0587.literal: Yangzhou Route's Chongming Prefecture suffered great wind; sea tides overflowed, washing away common people's dwellings.
s0587.idiomatic: Yangzhou Route's Chongming Prefecture suffered great wind; sea tides overflowed, washing away common people's dwellings.

s0588.literal: On renxu day Jupiter transgressed Well.
s0588.idiomatic: On renxu day Jupiter transgressed Well.

s0589.literal: On dingmao day the imperial carriage arrived from the Upper Capital.
s0589.idiomatic: On dingmao day the imperial carriage arrived from the Upper Capital.

s0590.literal: On gengwu day Attending Censor Xue Jujing was made central secretariat associate administrator.
s0590.idiomatic: On gengwu day attending censor Xue Jujing was made central secretariat associate administrator.

s0591.literal: On renwu day the moon transgressed Ghost.
s0591.idiomatic: On renwu day the moon transgressed Ghost.

s0592.literal: Ninth month: Sanggye Pal was made imperial preceptor.
s0592.idiomatic: Ninth month: Sanggye Pal was made imperial preceptor.

s0593.literal: On gusi day Xuanhui Court commissioner Wanze was made privy council administrator.
s0593.idiomatic: On gusi day Xuanhui Court commissioner Wanze was made privy council administrator.

s0594.literal: On wushen day Tuohuan was enfeoffed Prince of Anding and granted a gold seal.
s0594.idiomatic: On wushen day Tuohuan was enfeoffed Prince of Anding and granted a gold seal.

s0595.literal: An edict directed building Yinsi Mountain Monastery at Zhenjiang Route; burial mounds beside the monastery were not to be relocated.
s0595.idiomatic: An edict directed building Yinsi Mountain Monastery at Zhenjiang Route; burial mounds beside the monastery were not to be relocated.

s0596.literal: The capital suffered great drought; the Emperor asked the way to quell the disaster; Hanlin academician Cheng Jufu cited the affair of Tang's prayer at the Mulberry Grove; the Emperor praised and admonished him.
s0596.idiomatic: The capital suffered great drought; the Emperor asked the way to quell the disaster; Hanlin academician Cheng Jufu cited the affair of Tang's prayer at the Mulberry Grove; the Emperor praised and admonished him.

s0597.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jimao day an edict directed the central secretariat to deliberate on implementing the civil service examinations.
s0597.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on jimao day an edict directed the central secretariat to deliberate on implementing the civil service examinations.

s0598.literal: Budashili was enfeoffed Prince of Andre.
s0598.idiomatic: Budashili was enfeoffed Prince of Andre.

s0599.literal: On xinwei day Kunshan Prefecture's seat of government was moved to Taicang; Changping County's seat was moved to Xindian.
s0599.idiomatic: On xinwei day Kunshan Prefecture's seat of government was moved to Taicang; Changping County's seat was moved to Xindian.

s0600.literal: On guiwei day Yizhou of Liaoyang Route was placed under the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat.
s0600.idiomatic: On guiwei day Yizhou of Liaoyang Route was placed under the Liaoyang branch secretariat.
